summary: EV002’s complete n=18 profile reports global minimizers at b=2 and b=6, refuting the claim that every global minimizer has b=0. EV003 only registers the claim.
limitation: The refutation applies only to n=18. Balanced-only search retains the optimum value 25 here but excludes some global minimizers; EV003 adds no experimental evidence.
next_question: Must the search find one global minimizer or enumerate all global minimizers?
